name: SplitButton
description: Primary action button with adjacent secondary context menu backed by the shared ContextMenu element.

accessibility.structure: Two native buttons: primary action and menu toggle
accessibility.menu: Shared cu-context-menu with role=menu and focus restoration
accessibility.keyboard: Tab, Enter, Space, ArrowDown/ArrowUp on toggle, Arrow keys/Home/End/Escape in menu
accessibility.disabled: Both buttons unavailable when disabled/loading; toggle unavailable when no enabled actions
accessibility.appearance: Full-row hover, focus ring, forced colors and reduced motion
